notes: Runtime variant of the GOOGL conviction two-pass design (v0.3, real-data 4h 定档 2026-08-16). Signal from scripts/scan_googl_daily_signal.py (var/runtime/googl/googl_daily_signal.csv): position=GOOGL/FLAT + leverage_tier=offense/base/flat; target_leverage now 11.2/7.5. Pre-conviction: GOOGL close>ma60 + 10% trailing, no SPY regime, no max_hold. Conviction: close>ma20 fast re-entry. Leverage tiers (0.75x multiplier, real-data optimum): conviction in-market -> offense 11.2x, non-conviction in-market -> base 7.5x, defense 3.8x reserved. ramp_confirm_pct=0.5 杠杆爬坡（真实数据 4h 回测 2026-08-16 定档）：conviction 入场先以 base 7.5x 起步，直到上一根已收盘 close 相对入场价 ≥ +0.5% 才升满 11.2x（无前视：入场 bar 与确认 bar 均按 base 计盈亏）。ramp_pre_stop_pct=1.0 爬坡前收紧止损（2026-08-16 复盘改档 2.0→1.0）：仅对爬坡档（conviction/offense）在确认前用该宽度止损，确认后放宽回 stop_loss_pct 4%；未确认即下跌的单子更早离场。改档依据：全窗（2024-01→2026-08）与 router 窗（2026-03-04→08-07）两个窗口都显示最优在 0.9-1.25 平台期（全窗 0.9=+1818% / 1.0=+2113% / 1.1=+1992% / 2.0=+1267%），非单点尖峰；取 1.0 平台中心求最大收益。已知风险：左侧 0.75 是悬崖（+68%，击穿 2025-12-24 确认前回撤 -2.63% 误杀赢单），参数敏感需盯紧；0.5% 必杀赢单。真实回测（pre_stop 2.0 基线）：+535%/maxDD 79% -> +630%/maxDD 69%（仅爬坡）-> +1249%/maxDD 62%（加 pre_stop 2.0，stop=4）；改 1.0 后全窗 +2113%/maxDD 50%。Real-data 4h execution backtest (googl_minute.csv->4h, 2024-01->2026-08, capture_open_gaps): 15x/10x strictly dominated (+397%/maxDD 90% vs 11.2x/7.5x +535%/maxDD 79%); at funding 0.005%/8h ~+390%. Every 4% stop at 11.2x = ~45% equity hit. exchange_leverage=12 supports 11.2x offense. OKX GOOGL 4h data file optional; adapter falls back to daily-resolution bars when absent.
